snippet.title: Praise Be Evangeline - Released!
snippet.description:
#gojira #animation #animationmeme #visualnovel #yanderesimulator 


Download game here : https://azurextwilight.itch.io/praise-be-evangeline

Once upon a time, there lived a Saintess who could take away anyone's sorrow with a single touch. Everyone smiles after she's done with them. A lot. Never stopping.

Evangeline has finally been given a knight of her own. Sir Therion won the trial by combat, swore his whole life to her, and hasn't taken his eyes off her since. He would kill anyone who looks at her too long, and he's happy to tell you so.

She thinks it's sweet. 

She's sure she can fix him.

...Maybe.
